what: Partition Species Richness Into Different Components (in situ speciation, import, and export events)
title: Getting Started with insitu
text: speciation events classified using insitu::map_insitu_events() function, acknowledged, work , number import export events. following functions address different events discussed far summarize relative importance system interest. First, use insitu::decompose_diversity() function phylogeny PAM returned insitu::match_island_phylo() function, along events returned insitu::map_insitu_events() function determine number species, situ speciation events, import events, export events associated island. results insitu::decompose_diversity() function give us clearer picture species richness accumulated function. diversity decomposition can visualized using insitu::plot_diversity_decomposition() function.  stacked bar plot accentuates importance situ speciation contributing species richness Cuba, Hispaniola, Jamaica, Puerto Rico, also highlighting import export events. can compare events statistically use insitu::compare_islands() function, runs chi-squared Kruskal-Wallis tests determine whether event counts, situ rates, colonization rates differ across islands. comp_div object created using insitu::compare_islands() function list three elements: counts_test, insitu_rate_test, colonization_rate_test. one contains summary output test: - counts_test chi-squared test determines whether situ speciation, import, export counts differ across islands. - insitu_rate_test Kruskal-Wallis test determines whether situ speciation rates differ across islands. - colonization_rate_test Kruskal-Wallis test determines whether colonization rates differ across islands. results example printed : p-values test indicate event counts general differ islands, situ speciation colonization rates statistically significantly different islands.

title: Stochastic Character Mapping With insitu
text: Stochastic character mapping specialization ancestral state reconstruction (ASR) estimates history character state changes across branches, instead nodes traditional ASR. ape::ace(), used insitu::run_geo_asr(), traditional implementation ASR. Stochastic character mapping provides measures uncertainty estimated character state changes randomly sampling potential evolutionary histories across phylogeny. vignette, use stochastic character mapping estimate geographic history small sample Anolis lizards native Caribbean Islands. First, let’s load prepare Anolis example data used Getting Started vignette.
